data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Preserve arch-synthesis inconclusive fallback explicitly. After collecting deep-tier specialist slot files, the runner validates each slot file (exists + non-empty + valid JSON). If any slot file fails validation, the arch synthesis is skipped and the runner emits an inconclusive FINDINGS_JSON (same fallback as the light/standard path). This existing behavior must be preserved unchanged when the curl calls are replaced with llm-api-call.sh redirections to slot files.
